Homepage background video
=========================

File used by the Czech and English homepages: hero-video.mp4

To replace the temporary film, overwrite hero-video.mp4 while keeping the
same filename. The text, menu and buttons are intentionally displayed above
the video. Use a short, silent 16:9 MP4 for the best result.

Temporary source: https://www.pexels.com/video/people-look-and-check-the-clothes-at-the-store-4750039/
License: https://www.pexels.com/license/

This temporary stock footage is not footage of La Belle Boutique and must
not be presented as such.
